name: Frankincense Eye Cream
short_description: A gentle yet effective eye cream with pure Omani Frankincense to hydrate, brighten, and reduce signs of fatigue around the eyes.
description:
Revive and care for the most delicate part of your face with Luban’s Frankincense Eye Cream. Infused with the natural power of pure Omani Frankincense, this lightweight cream hydrates and soothes while working to reduce puffiness, dark circles, and fine lines.

Its nourishing formula helps firm and brighten the under-eye area, giving you a refreshed, well-rested look — even on your busiest days.

Gentle enough for daily use, powerful enough to make a visible difference.

name: Frankincense Night Cream
short_description: A rich, restorative night cream with pure Omani Frankincense to hydrate, repair, and rejuvenate your skin while you sleep.
description:
End your day with deep nourishment. Luban’s Frankincense Night Cream is crafted to work in harmony with your skin’s natural overnight repair process. Infused with pure Omani Frankincense, this luxurious cream soothes and protects while delivering long-lasting hydration.

It helps reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and dullness — leaving your skin visibly firmer, brighter, and more youthful by morning. With a soft, calming scent and a deeply moisturizing formula, it’s the perfect way to restore balance and beauty while you rest.

name: Frankincense Day Cream
short_description: A lightweight yet powerful day cream infused with 100% pure Omani Frankincense to hydrate, firm, and protect your skin all day long.
description:
Start your day with a ritual of natural care. Luban’s Frankincense Day Cream is formulated with pure Omani Frankincense to deliver deep hydration while firming and brightening the skin. Rich in natural antioxidants and skin-repairing ingredients, it helps reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and age spots.

Lightweight and fast-absorbing, this cream creates a smooth base for your day while shielding your skin from UV damage and environmental stressors. Suitable for all skin types, it leaves your face feeling nourished, protected, and naturally radiant — every single day.
